d:
Jharkhand ke simdega se bari khabar samne aaee hai. vidhayak bhushan bara par ek nabalig ne yaun shoshan ka aarop lagaya hai. mamle men POCSO ekt ke tahat kes darj kiya gaya hai. aarop lagane vali nabalig dhurva thane bhi pahunchi. aakhir kya hai pura mamla aur is par aage kya karravaee hoti hai? dekhie is riport men.
